text: yeah that intersecting is full of shit man i was trying to figure that out why it happens. if u noticed it is considering your wheel wells as intersections. because there is a join at the direction change on the edge... total failure to realize its not intersecting if this is the case. We need to fix that. Your model is actually a great start and would be what i would do also, so based on that notion the thing yelling back at you that its intersecting is just flat out wrong
resolution: Root-caused the phantom intersecting count: the audit's per-edge ray test registered boundary grazes as penetrations — every flagged contact on the police_sedan sat at barycentric u/v/w of exactly 0 or 1 (T-junction verts resting mid-edge, wheel-well walls rising off underbody edge lines). Replaced penetrates() with the standard tri-tri interval test plus a 1e-4m touch deadband: both triangles must strictly straddle each other's plane and the crossing interval must have real length, so joins at direction changes can never count while genuine stabs still do. Added T-join regression + genuine-stab control fixtures; test-mesh-audit 9/9; offline replica on the saved sedan mesh reports 0 (was 16). Editor binary needs a rebuild to pick it up.
